snippet.title: TEKNOKRAT | a sci-fi thriller romance visual novel
snippet.description:
Announcement trailer/OP for TEKNOKRAT by Vertebrae Entertainment, demo available now!
https://vertebrae-entertainment.itch.io/teknokrat

TEKNOKRAT is a gay, y2k-fuelled sci-fi thriller/romance about the danger of enforced stagnation in the face of unstoppable change. 

In the futuristic techno-metropolis of Nu-Vika, you are but a number in the system. You have been branded as unemployed, and rely on the state to survive. Until you are assigned a temporary position at a cyborg repair workshop,  giving you a shot at gaining freedom. But when strange glitches start happening to your eye implants, you find yourself thrust into a plan far beyond your comprehension, tying your fate to one of three patients in your care.

The full game is currently a work in progress, estimated at 75k words, and features three love interests and six endings.

Playable demo:
https://vertebrae-entertainment.itch.io/teknokrat

Follow us on bluesky for future updates.
